title: wgc/source@0: Stage 0 source inventory and segment map
description: DRAFT @0. The inventory (`source/inventory.yaml`) is committed. Segment TEXT is never committed (copyright): it is re-extracted deterministically into the local cache and verified against `text_hash` and `struct_hash`.

source_document.description: SRC-…: one input document. Every expected input is listed, also missing ones (`present: false`), so a gap is visible before analysis starts.

complete.description: false when the document is known to lack content other sources must supply

precedence.description: higher wins on an explicit conflict; overrides the default by role (wgc.source.DEFAULT_PRECEDENCE: errata > living_rules > rules and printed components > faq > designer_clarification > community_interpretation)

edition_skew.description: known mismatch with the main rules edition

seg_prefix.description: key prefix of this document's segment ids (SEG-<seg_prefix>.<label>); default: the key of the SRC- id

extractor.description: deterministic extractor and version used, e.g. wgc.ingest.markdown@1

hybrid_hash.description: hash of approved hybrid evidence in .glu/source/<SRC-id>/hybrid/approved.json

segment.description: SEG-…: smallest addressable unit of source text (numbered rule paragraph, table, box, example). Provenance anchors point here.

label.description: rule number or label as printed, e.g. 3.4

areas.description: page-specific source regions; unlike bbox, includes every page of a spanning segment

text_hash.description: hash of the normalized text (NFC, whitespace-collapsed, hyphenation joined)

struct_hash.description: versioned hash of the lines and table cells of the extracted text (wgc/struct@N, ADR-0032); written by extractors @1+, required before tasks read the segment

verified_by_render.description: true when a page render confirmed the extraction
